item.title: Actor Ananya Raj dies: Family says she died peacefully in sleep; fans mourn her work
item.summary: Actor Ananya Raj, known for '7 Hours to Go', 'The Final Exit' and 'Ghost', passed away at 27 on July 15 after battling physical and mental health issues for over a year. Her family shared the news on Instagram, calling her a "strong spirited girl." She also worked in regional films like 'Thaggede Le'.
